letterNodesCrustyCoByDay.body: Crustacean Corporation is excited to announce an additional commuter shuttle route for Crustacean Corporation’s guests and employees! Shuttle passengers will present their exclusive shuttle tickets at the kiosk. Make sure to assign these passengers to the correct seats.

Many of you may have recently heard about the tragic incident that befell the child of one of our employees. In light of the rising cases of such disturbing behavior, the board has decided to revise our policies and goals to bolster public safety. Everyone must eat, but that cannot extend to devouring those who have not even lived yet.
In the meantime, stay vigilant against dangerous creatures and protect yourself.

For today, when you see predator-type passengers, please send them on the shuttle along with the usual employees, regardless of their ticket. Passengers will be compensated accordingly for their trouble, so don’t worry about any negative reviews. We’ll take care of that.
Do not disappoint us, Operator.
letterNodesCrustyCoByDay.bottom:
Thank you for your cooperation,
Crustacean Corporation

letterNodesCrustyCoByDay.top: This notice is restricted from public view:
letterNodesCrustyCoByDay.body: Please note the new policy revision: non-crustacean passengers must also be sent on the shuttle along with employees, regardless of their ticket.
letterNodesCrustyCoByDay.bottom:
Thank you for your cooperation,
Crustacean Corporation

letterNodesCrustyCoByDay_GoodEnding.body: Many of you may have recently heard news about creatures with abnormal appendages accusing the company of illegal experimentation. These claims are not true; they are false accusations made by disgruntled employees who did not meet expectations on our recent projects and were subsequently released. We will be taking action against these false claims and those who are trying to bring our decades of work down.

Congratulations! For your excellent performance, you are eligible to receive the salary bonus for this month. Crustacean Corporation thanks you for your dedication and loyalty. Please keep up the good work.

letterNodesCrustyCoByDay_BadEnding.body:
After passing the clinical trials, we are proud to finally unveil our new rehabilitation medicine. This has been our grandest undertaking since our founding, and it could not have been achieved without the sacrifices and hard work of all involved. This new medicine promises to improve all aspects of crustacean well-being and suppress any undesirable “base” urges.
As a final announcement, employees will be mandated to undergo the treatment by the end of next month.
letterNodesCrustyCoByDay_BadEnding.bottom:
May the crustacean era be glorious,
Crustacean Corporation

letterNodesCrustyCoByDay_BadEnding.body: We commend you on finishing your first month on the job. However, we noticed many discrepancies in the number of guests you sent and the number of guests we actually received, on numerous days. Going forward, we will be placing you on a performance improvement plan, to ensure that you consistently follow company policies in your work.

letterNodesCrustyCoByID.body: Crustacean Station strives to provide a quality experience to our passengers. However, we have recently received numerous complaints about your conduct and service. To meet the standards expected of you for this position, we ask you to improve by paying closer attention to passenger needs. Failure to improve performance may result in your termination.
letterNodesCrustyCoByID.bottom:
Thank you for your cooperation,
Crustacean Corporation

letterNodesCrustyCoByID.body: As an employee of Crustacean Corporation, you are obligated to follow company directions. Failure to comply with orders may result in termination of your employment.
letterNodesCrustyCoByID.bottom:
Thank you for your cooperation,
Crustacean Corporation

letterNodesCrustyCoByID.body:
Crustacean Corporation would like to commend you for your excellent performance thus far, and encourage you to keep up the good work.
As a reminder, at the end of each month, employees with exemplary performance evaluations are eligible to receive a salary bonus.

Crustacean Station would like to remind you of the importance of keeping all passengers safe. We are a transportation service, not a dining establishment.
We have offered condolences to the affected family. Although such behavior by the offender is considered “legal” in current times, we ask you to minimize incidents as much as possible.

Welcome to your new job as an entry-level kiosk operator at Crustacean Station! Your position is critical to the operation of this station and the satisfaction of each crustacean. We are excited to onboard you soon.
Crustacean Corporation reminds you once more that safety and satisfaction are paramount. As such, please make sure to follow relevant regulations and orders.
letterNodesCrustyCoByID.bottom:
We wish you the best of luck,
Crustacean Corporation

letterNodesFamily.body:
Spot me a train ticket, will ya? I’ve been dying to go to one of (band’s) concerts, but I’m running low on cash.
Help a brother out ;)

We settled Mom at the new nursing home. She’s a bit more stable now, so you just need to keep the payments coming, and we can take care of her.

I know you don’t really want to get too involved, but this is the least you can do for your family.

Thank you for keeping my son safe. I know he’s caused you trouble, and I sincerely apologize. With how busy the lab is and his father out of the picture, I can’t take him to school myself. I told him to talk to you if he had questions, so I’m begging you to please keep an eye on him in my absence.

letterNodesMailkeeper.body:
We’ve seen each other a few times now, but I haven’t had the chance to introduce myself. I’m the mailkeeper, and I’m the one who delivers your station feedback and letters! It’s tough work, but seeing your smile makes it all worth it :)

Life can be tough, yeah? So no matter what, just know you’ve got an ally in me.

I got lucky with a low tide shift today, so I got to visit my family!

They gifted me a lot of shells. I have too many, and we’re about the same size, so I was thinking maybe you’d like them? Oh, you can’t refuse by the way, I already dropped them off at your home!
A new brinery opened up in the nearby reeftown. Wanna go check it out? I hear their new sea pickles are to die for. And honestly, if I had to die, I’d want it to be with you…

You’ve noticed it too, right? All those passengers…

For the past few weeks, I saw a lot of creatures wearing bandages. I thought they were just wrapping up because of the gloomy weather, but now…it’s just plain horrifying. How did this happen? The enforcement corps has to be investigating this, right?
